Paragraph: "Oh Lakshmana, see how the sun sets behind the western mountains, painting the sky in shades of crimson and gold!"
Situation/Problem_Faced: Watching the vivid sunset over the western mountains at the end of a long day.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama directs Lakshmana's gaze to the vibrant sunset sky.
Outcome/Resolution: He shares a moment of awe at the close of day.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Sunset Mindfulness, Visual Awe, Time Transition

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Sandhya (The sacred transition time of twilight invoking quiet reflection)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Twilight (Sandhya) serves as a cosmic reminder to still the mind and connect with the eternal beyond daily turmoil.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Using the quiet, awe-inspiring transition of sunset to pause, ground, and regulate emotional state.
